profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public technology company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California. According to its website, NVIDIA develops AI foundation models and inference infrastructure for enterprise applications. The company reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 as of January 25, 2026.

NVIDIA's AI product portfolio includes the Nemotron family of multimodal foundation models, described on its site as highly efficient open models built for long-running, self-evolving agents. The company states that Nemotron models deliver reasoning capabilities for complex agent workflows including RAG, speech recognition, text-to-speech, neural machine translation, and document retrieval. NVIDIA also offers NVIDIA NIM, inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. The company publishes Nemotron model weights, training datasets, and training techniques under the NVIDIA Open Model License, a permissive license allowing commercial use without attribution.

The held facts indicate NVIDIA has a page on theworldofai.org and faces 220 lawsuits in California. The company's CIK is 0001045810 and trades under ticker NVDA.
